changes.comment: `isReplyTo` and `parseReply` no longer appear in the published declarations. They were `@internal` and absent from the barrel, but exported for a sibling module, so they reached `dist/types/store/call.d.ts` while TypeDoc's `excludeInternal` kept them out of the reference — the two disagreed, and a consumer reviewing the package read `isReplyTo` in the declarations and reasonably concluded it was public API. Both now live beside their only caller, unexported, so the declarations for the call surface carry exactly `ReplySpec`, `CallOptions`, `CallHandle`, `CallTimeoutError` and `CallAbortedError`. No runtime behaviour changes; if you need reply correlation as public API, ask rather than reaching for the declaration.
